articles.title: Why is the women's 800m record so tough to break?
articles.description: The world record for the women's 800m is the longest standing in athletics. No-one has managed to break it for 43 years. Why is it such a tough task?

articles.title: 'Total domination' - GB's Glave & Azu claim European 100m one-two
articles.description: Great Britain's Romell Glave and Jeremiah Azu claim a sensational European 100m one-two for the hosts in Birmingham.

articles.title: Grand Slam Track athletes deny Johnson claim they have been paid
articles.description: Athletes promised thousands of pounds in payments for participating in Grand Slam Track events are still waiting for their money.

articles.title: Eclipse chasers scramble for glasses as stocks run low
articles.description: Specialist glasses are all but sold out online ahead of the UK's most significant eclipse since 1999.

articles.title: Summer 2026 on course to be UK's hottest on record, says Met Office
articles.description: Only average conditions are needed for the remainder of August to break the record, which was set just last year.

articles.title: Hodgkinson and gold medal rivals progress at Europeans
articles.description: Keely Hodgkinson and gold medal rivals Audrey Werro and Femke Broeders-Bol progress to remain on course for a tantalising European 800m showdown.
